market_definition: Global Data Center Market: data center facilities - enterprise / institutional, colocation (retail and wholesale), hyperscale / cloud, telecom and edge - and their development, operation, capacity expansion and infrastructure. By Component - Hardware: servers (rack, blade, other), storage (DAS, NAS, SAN, other), network infrastructure (switches, routers, NICs, load balancers, security appliances, structured cabling, other), power infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, switchgear, transfer switches, transformers, backup generators, battery energy storage, other), cooling (IT-space air and liquid cooling, central cooling and heat rejection, coolant distribution, other), racks and enclosures (racks, cabinets, hot/cold-aisle containment, cable management, other), fire and life safety (detection, suppression, leak detection, alarms, EPO, other), physical security (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, other). Software: DCIM, building and facility management, energy and power, environmental and thermal, digital twin and capacity planning, predictive maintenance and automation, sustainability and carbon, other. Services: consulting, design and engineering; installation and systems integration; testing and commissioning; maintenance and technical support; managed infrastructure; migration and modernization; other specialized. By IT load: below 1 MW to 100 MW and above. End use: IT and telecom, BFSI, healthcare, retail and e-commerce, manufacturing, energy and utilities, government, media, education and research, transportation and logistics, others. Geography: global. EXCLUDED from the market: general commercial buildings, telecom towers, network switching facilities and other IT or communication facilities that are not dedicated data centers. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DATA CENTER DISTRIBUTOR: a company whose primary business is buying data center products in volume from OEMs and reselling them onward - broadline IT distributors, value-added distributors (VADs) and specialist distributors of servers, storage, networking, power (UPS, PDUs, switchgear, generators), cooling, racks and cabling, fire and security systems and DCIM software - supplying resellers, system integrators and end customers, and manufacturing none of what it sells. EXCLUDED companies: OEMs and manufacturers (e.g. Dell, HPE, Cisco, Schneider Electric, Vertiv, Eaton), data center operators (colocation, cloud, hyperscale, telecom), system integrators and solution providers that sell projects to end users, IT resellers, VARs and managed-service providers, maintenance-only firms, and building or telecom-tower contractors.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
